items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That writer in the New York Times, New York Magazine, Whitney Balliett. Then I started getting all these good gigs

ctx.x: You said “when I got popular.” How did you become popular again?
That writer in the New York Times, New York Magazine, Whitney Balliett. Then I started getting all these good gigs, that don’t last too long and pay more money.
How does your performance fit into that program compared to your own either solo or trio performance.
